title: Add foundational AL developer knowledge
summary: Adds seven foundational AL knowledge articles covering document default initialization, directed rounding, guarded interface casts, dropdown visibility, page-part refresh, and install/upgrade ordering and version context. Related review skills get targeted retrieval cues.

Guarded interface casting with is (runtime 15.0, BC 25+)
